implementation_summary.spacetime_dimension: solve-series accepts --spacetime-dimension and applies the expression to the C++ ProblemSpec and SolveRequest dimension binding.
implementation_summary.user_defined_amfmode: solve-series accepts --amfmode, registers the reviewed AMFlow usr AMFPosition hook, and emits the selected eta insertion decision.
implementation_summary.user_defined_ending: solve-series accepts --ending, registers the reviewed AMFlow usr EndingScheme hook, and emits the terminal ending decision.
implementation_summary.retained_state_parser: retained boundary parsing now supports Gamma products, ratios, powers, Pi, and Mathematica scientific notation in real boundary expressions.

feature_rows.anti_fake_control: The same direct input without --spacetime-dimension outputs exact_real=4; with --spacetime-dimension 7/3 it outputs exact_real=7/3 and matches the non-default AMFlow golden.

feature_rows.probe_scope: scoped retained target box1[-2,1,1,2] from the AMFlow user_defined_amfmode example; retained-state scoped exception, not full live AMFlow regeneration
feature_rows.anti_fake_control: The scoped retained state exits 2 without --amfmode usr. With --amfmode usr it emits eta_mode_decision.mode_name=usr and selected_propagator_positions=[1,3], then matches six AMFlow coefficients.

feature_rows.probe_scope: scoped retained target box1[-2,1,1,2] from the AMFlow user_defined_ending final_usr example; retained-state scoped exception, not full live AMFlow regeneration
feature_rows.anti_fake_control: The scoped retained state exits 2 without --ending usr. With --ending usr it emits ending_decision.terminal_strategy=usr-two-top-position-ending and matches six AMFlow coefficients.
